title: RouteLLM: threshold-gated strong/weak model selection
purpose: Choose between one strong and one weak model per prompt by comparing a predicted strong-model win rate against a caller-supplied threshold.

interface.request: an OpenAI chat-completions body; only the last message is scored (routellm/controller.py:110)
interface.response: the upstream completion, unwrapped, with the served model name in the `model` field (routellm/controller.py:153, routellm/openai_server.py:133)
interface.config: one scalar threshold encoded in the model string; calibrated offline (routellm/calibrate_threshold.py:55)

model_selection.property: Binary strong-vs-weak: a predicted strong-model win rate at or above the caller's threshold selects the strong model, otherwise the weak one, scored from the last message only.
model_selection.guarantee: Selection is a deterministic pure function of the prompt for the mf/bert/causal_llm/sw_ranking routers; it guarantees nothing about the realised quality, only about the strong-call fraction it was calibrated to.

placement.property: not decided: there is no endpoint or deployment concept; one global api_base/api_key is handed to the underlying client.

admission_and_overload.property: not decided: the only rejection is a 400 for a malformed router/threshold string; there is no queue and no overload signal.

rate_limit_pacing.property: not decided: no request or token quota accounting exists anywhere in the package.

retry_and_fallback.property: not decided: the upstream result is returned directly and an upstream failure is not caught, retried or diverted.

outage_and_health.property: not decided for upstreams: the health endpoint reports only that the router process is alive.

deadline_and_priority.property: not decided: the request model carries no deadline, SLO or latency field.

tenant_isolation.property: not decided: one process-global controller and one shared decision tally serve every caller.

cost_control.property: Spend is never computed or bounded at decision time; the quantity the project calls cost is the fraction of calls sent to the strong model, and the threshold is tuned offline to hit a target fraction on someone else's traffic.
cost_control.guarantee: It bounds the share of traffic sent to the expensive model on the calibration distribution only; the realised share on a different workload is explicitly not guaranteed.

policy_state_and_determinism.property: A deterministic pure function of the prompt for the trained routers; the only unbounded state is an ever-growing per-router decision tally, and the random router is non-deterministic and only seeded inside the evaluation harness.
policy_state_and_determinism.guarantee: Two runs of a trained router on the same prompt give the same model; memory grows with the number of distinct routers, not requests.

decision_observability.property: The served model is visible in the response and the running decision counts are logged, but no score, reason or spend is returned to the caller.
decision_observability.guarantee: An operator can see WHICH model served a request but not WHY.
